findings.evidence: Mathlib `Eigenspace/Basic.lean:720` gives `eigenspaces_iSupIndep` under domain/torsion-free assumptions; distinct eigenvalue tuples differ at one coordinate, and the usual finite-family eigenvector argument needs no operators to commute.
findings.fix: Prove joint-eigenspace independence directly under `[CommRing K] [IsDomain K] [Module K V] [Module.IsTorsionFree K V]`, with no commutation argument, then derive the character-indexed form from it.
findings.issue: `iSupIndep_iInf_eigenspace_of_commute` unnecessarily requires `[Field K]` and pairwise commutation; line 252 propagates both restrictions to the character-indexed independence theorem.

findings.evidence: `MulChar.sum_eq_zero_of_ne_one` is declared under `[CommRing R'] [IsDomain R']` at `MulChar/Basic.lean:607`, and `MulChar.card_eq_card_units_of_hasEnoughRootsOfUnity` is ring-general at `MulChar/Duality.lean:74`; the only field-specific operation here is `(Nat.card G : K)⁻¹`.
findings.fix: Move the Fourier section outside `FieldScalars`, use `[CommRing K] [IsDomain K]`, replace field inverse/`[NeZero ...]` by an explicit inverse obtained from `IsUnit (Nat.card G : K)`, and expose that hypothesis on the public theorems.
findings.issue: Both public Fourier decomposition theorems at lines 387 and 397 inherit `[Field K]`, although the argument only needs a commutative domain and invertibility of `(Nat.card G : K)`.

findings.evidence: The proof's `smul_left_inj` is declared under `[Ring R] [IsCancelMulZero R] [IsTorsionFree R M]` in `Algebra/Module/Torsion/Free.lean:176`; the remaining product-to-unit steps are explicit equalities to `1`.
findings.issue: The elementary joint-eigenvalue API at lines 106–165 assumes `[IsDomain K]`, while its scalar cancellation only requires `[IsCancelMulZero K]`; the group inverse construction itself uses no domain property.

summary: Several APIs still impose stronger scalar or commutation assumptions than their natural statements require.
